gloss: to wear out; to fray; to become threadbare

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {擦|す}り{切|き}れませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {擦|す}り{切|き}れていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {擦|す}り{切|き}れていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to wear out; to fray; to become threadbare
definitions.explanation: for fabric, rope, or similar materials to become worn or frayed through friction or repeated use

examples.japanese: ⟦ズボン→ズボン：01072_zubon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{切|き}れた。
examples.english: The knees of my pants wore through.

examples.japanese: ⟦{靴下|くつした}→靴下：00726_kutsushita⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{切|き}れて⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}いた→開く：00689_aku⟧。
examples.english: My socks wore out and got holes in them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{背表紙|せびょうし}→背表紙：15671_sebyoushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{切|き}れて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The book's spine is worn from being read so many times.

notes:
{擦|す}り{切|き}れる describes things wearing thin or through from friction or repeated use. A compound verb from {擦|す}る (to rub) + ⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ (to break/snap).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Pair: {擦|す}り{切|き}る (transitive — to wear something out)
- Pattern: 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{切|き}れる

ASPECT (ている):
- {擦|す}り{切|き}れて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: is worn out (resulting state)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{靴下|くつした}→靴下：00726_kutsushita⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{切|き}れる: socks wear out
- ⟦ズボン→ズボン：01072_zubon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{切|き}れる: pants knees wear through
- {本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{背表紙|せびょうし}→背表紙：15671_sebyoushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{切|き}れる: book spine wears out
- ⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{擦|す}り{切|き}れる: rope frays through

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{破|やぶ}れる→破れる：02322_yabureru⟧: to tear, to rip
- ⟦{傷|いた}む→傷む：10061_itamu⟧: to become damaged
- ⟦{古|ふる}びる→古びる：11950_furubiru⟧: to become old/worn looking
